_comment: How to cut each garment out of its drop, as fractions of that drop's own bounding box. Per item because the drops are not one figure re-dressed: the hat drops are head-and-shoulders portraits (aspect 0.68 to 1.03, widest at 30-50% of height) and the apron drops are full-length figures (aspect 0.36 to 0.56, widest at 20-30%), while the body sheet is 0.53. No single registration fits all three, so the band is authored and /dev/align's eraser finishes the job.

_fields.top: band starts here, as a fraction of the drop's height
_fields.left: band starts here across the drop's width
_fields.widthPct: finished width as a fraction of the body figure's own width
_fields.anchorY: where the overlay's top sits, as a fraction of the 48px body frame
